data.title: Turkey seeks Interpol arrest warrant for Netanyahu over Gaza flotilla detention
data.description: Turkey said Friday it is seeking an international arrest warrant from Interpol for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as part of a domestic criminal case over Israel's interception and detention of dozens of activists attempting to deliver humanitarian aid to the besieged Gaza Strip in May. data.title: Millions in Cuba face water shortages as oil crisis deepens
data.description: In Cuba, seven months of an effective oil blockade imposed by the Trump administration has not only increased power outages but is also leaving more and more people without running water. In August 2025, 2.6 million people on the Caribbean island nation had difficulty accessing water, according to the Cuban Institute of Hydraulic Resources. Today, that figure has risen to 3.5 million – around a third of the population. FRANCE 24’s Ed Augustin reports on the health risks rippling through the island.

data.title: Deadly daytime heat turns Japanese farmers nocturnal
data.description: Japan's farmers are opting for more nocturnal schedules as daytime summer heat makes working conditions dangerous. North of Tokyo, Motoaki Iijima harvests flowers in his illuminated greenhouse long after sunset. The farmer was pushed to  make a dramatic change after a worker suffered heatstroke picking sunflowers in the greenhouse three summers prior. A few towns away, poultry farmer Tetsuya Usuba has also adopted a nocturnal schedule, waking his flock at 2:30 am to eat.

data.title: What a record-breaking El Nino could mean for the world
data.description: This year's El Nino is on track to be the strongest on record, threatening to unleash extreme weather across the globe and make 2027 the hottest recorded year by far. It is expected to be the most "intense" El Nino in more than a century, the head of long-range forecasting at the UK's Met Office warned on Friday. Stacked on top of long-term human-caused climate change, the temporary jolt will offer a glimpse of the heat the world can expect by the late 2030s, experts say.

data.title: Netanyahu focused on reelection as Israeli govt grows 'less concerned' about international isolation
data.description: Annette Young is pleased to welcome Dr. Aaron Y. Zelin, Senior Fellow at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy. He sees Israel’s recent actions in the West Bank and Syria as part of a broader shift in its strategic posture. Since October 7, the Israeli government has become markedly less concerned with international opinion, prioritizing what it defines as its security interests even at the cost of growing diplomatic isolation. Domestic politics matter here. With elections approaching, some recent military activity can also be understood through an electoral lens. But he would distinguish that from Israel’s increasingly confrontational posture toward Turkey, which predates the current election cycle. As Iran and its regional proxy network have been weakened, figures around the Israeli prime minister have increasingly framed Turkey as a potential future strategic challenge.

data.title: Hopes fade after Central African Republic gold mine collapse kills dozens
data.description: Hopes of finding survivors at a collapsed gold mine in Central African Republic were fading Thursday, two days after a disaster that local officials and the Red Cross said killed more than 100 people, although the government put the death toll at 49. Thirty-five Central Africans, 13 Cameroonians and two Chadians died in the collapse, Mines Minister Rufin Benam Beltoungou told independent broadcaster Radio Ndeke Luka. His toll was significantly lower than figures provided by local officials, witnesses and relatives of victims, who have said more than 100 people died.

data.title: Prince Harry and Meghan are returning to the UK with their children
data.description: Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, have decided to return to the United Kingdom for an extended stay starting this fall, but they won’t resume their roles as working members of the royal family, The Associated Press learned Wednesday. The couple's children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, have already enrolled at British schools and will start classes in September, according to a person close to the Sussexes who was not authorized to speak publicly. The family plans to live at a private, non-royal residence outside of London, but plans to maintain their home in Montecito, California, and their vacation property in Portugal.

data.title: A party, 101 princesses and an eccentric millionaire: Jon Ronson on a mysterious castle – and what it taught him about masculinity in crisis
data.description: When my son texted me from a Connecticut fortress in the middle of the night with an alarming message, it set me on a quest to understand the bizarre lifestyle of its owner I awoke one morning in the summer of 2023 to discover that, while I’d slept, my son Joel had been texting my wife and me a series of unnerving messages about a perilous situation he had found himself in, in Connecticut. From what I could tell, as I frantically tried to piece together the night’s events, one of Joel’s friends had been invited to a party being held by a stranger she’d met that week on Tinder. So Joel and two others went along for the ride. But when they arrived, they found the man’s home so bizarre that Joel did something he’d never done before – he sent me the coordinates of his location and a photograph, just in case. data.title: When TV turns sour: the shows we simply can’t stomach any more
data.description: They were once the hottest shows on television – gripping, sexy, hilarious, zeitgeisty. But for our writers, the likes of America’s Next Top Model, House of Cards and The Office are now part of their viewing history they feel tainted by When I think of the summer holidays when I was a teenager, I think of watching America’s Next Top Model for hours on end, critiquing each contestant with my sister. The makeover episode was always my favourite: girls sobbing as their hair was cropped short, or even shaved off. At the time, Tyra Banks seemed like a big sister, giving the contestants the tough love they’d need to succeed in a ferociously competitive industry. Now I feel differently. I hadn’t watched America’s Next Top Model since I was young, but like many, I recently watched Netflix’s excellent series , Reality Check: Inside America’s Next Top Model. It was the strangest sensation, rewatching episodes I hadn’t seen in more than two decades. At times I felt almost teleported back. How could I not find these scenes of models collapsing with hunger utterly abhorrent? I wondered what influence watching a show that celebrated eating disorders had on my own brain. I think it had an impact. I think the residual taint of it is still there. I can’t watch America’s Next Top Model any more, nor do I want to. Ironically, it’s all too ugly. Sirin Kale Continue reading...

data.title: It’s Harry and Meghan in Finding Freedom 2: Back in Blighty | Marina Hyde
data.description: Hard to fathom exactly why Megxit is over and the self-exiled wonder generators are leaving California. Luckily, the internet sleuths are on the case Wednesday night brought an absolute cloudburst of psychic rain for our parched land, as it emerged that Prince Harry and Meghan were reversing their self-styled “freedom flight” to California and returning to live in the UK . Nature is healing! Is that … is that how the expression goes? Either way, all humans in Britain have taken the announcement brilliantly, while fatted calf prices climbed steeply at the news that the reverse Megxit is imminent, with only an adequate headline soubriquet yet to be found. Megain? Megraine? Inevitably, thoughts turned swiftly to what it all meant. One of the funniest aspects of Meghan and Harry coverage is how their decisions are always analysed as though we were parsing the 4D chess moves of 19th-century master strategists. We are forever imagining we are dealing with a couple of Bismarcks or Clausewitzes, as opposed to a resting actor and the “ chief impact officer ” of a firm designed to offer tech-based solutions to men crying in their cars or something. Marina Hyde is a Guardian columnist What a Time to be Alive! by Marina Hyde (Guardian Faber Publishing, £20) is released in September. To support the Guardian, order your copy at guardianbookshop.com . Delivery charges may apply. Continue reading...

data.title: Mike D: ‘After Yauch died I couldn’t make music. I’d open a computer file and just feel sadness’
data.description: As part of the Beastie Boys, the rapper shot to fame and notoriety in the 80s, before bandmate Adam Yauch’s death saw him withdraw from the spotlight. He returns with a solo album that sees him reckon with greed, mortality – and his past ‘It’s funny how far a joke will get you,” Michael Diamond grins. This time 40 years ago, the New York rapper known as Mike D was working with schoolfriends Adam “MCA” Yauch and Adam “Ad-Rock” Horovitz on Licensed to Ill, their 1986 debut album as the Beastie Boys. The “joke” in question is that record’s cartoonish send-up of frat-bro culture, set to fusions of hard rock riffs and hip-hop beats. As for how far it got them: destinations included global stardom, a page in the history books with rap’s first US chart-topping album, and the crosshairs of British tabloids as they roused a generation to “fight for your right to party”. data.title: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists

data.title: Lindsay Clancy killed her children. Why do many women support her? – Stateside with Kai and Carter
data.description: The trial of Lindsay Clancy, a former nurse accused of murdering her three children, is wrapping up its fifth week. On Friday morning, the defense rested, and the public attention to the case is at a fever-pitch — especially on social media. Clancy, 36, does not deny that she strangled her children, but has pleaded not guilty due to lack of criminal responsibility, also known as an insanity defense. She argues that she was in the throes of postpartum psychosis, a rare and devastating condition that can go unrecognized and untreated. Host Carter Sherman speaks with Jenna Amatulli , deputy head of news for Guardian US, about how the case has renewed attention on the fundamental shortcomings in the US's maternal healthcare system, and about why Clancy's story has captivated – and polarized – so many people Continue reading...

data.title: You’re Killing Me review – did an AI monkey write this terrible Brooke Shields crime caper?
data.description: I desperately wanted this show to be Gilmore Girls meets Murder, She Wrote – but the story of a novelist turned amateur sleuth is just so lazy. And yet, I still have high hopes for the confirmed second season Look, we all want Brooke Shields to be in gainful employment. We all want her to have a fabulous third act to her career. God knows, the child model turned star of prurient fever dreams Pretty Baby and The Blue Lagoon (and the “Nothing comes between me and my Calvins” jeans ad campaign when she was 15) has earned it. Plus, she did a fine turn in Friends and a number of us remember Suddenly Susan very fondly. But she’s terrible in the terrible new thing she’s in, which is a six-part comedy drama called You’re Killing Me. Shields plays successful cosy mystery novelist Allison Chandler, who lives in the picturesque town of Founder’s Cove, Maine. It’s Murder, She Wrote vibes all right, but please lower your expectations. Continue reading...

data.title: David Harbour has blown Tony Stark’s cover in Avengers: Doomsday. It might just be what Marvel needs
data.description: The actor, who plays Red Guardian in the film, made a cryptic comment to Variety that raised more Robert Downey Jr-shaped questions than answers. But was it a clanger, or expert trolling? Nobody knows exactly what solemn blood oaths Marvel uses to prevent spoilers. But we do know that Andrew Garfield spent most of the run-up to 2021’s Spider-Man: No Way Home – in which he would eventually turn up as one of two secret Spideys – behaving as if Kevin Feige was standing behind him, holding up a giant card saying: YOU HAVE NEVER MET TOBEY MAGUIRE . So we can imagine it’s pretty full on. Why, then, has Avengers: Doomsday star David Harbour this week apparently blurted out the biggest Marvel secret since Ben Kingsley’s Mandarin in Iron Man 3? Invited by Variety magazine to offer up a line from Doomsday “completely out of context”, Harbour thought for a moment, adopted the Russian accent of his Red Guardian character and came out with : “You … are Tony Stark.” Which is quite a thing to say about a film whose entire marketing campaign so far has depended on us accepting that Iron Man remains dead, and that the actor who used to play him, Robert Downey Jr, is playing Victor von Doom instead. Continue reading...

data.title: Arsenal sweep Coventry aside to start Premier League title defence in style
data.description: What a difference a title makes. The last time Arsenal played in front of their own supporters, you could cut the nervous tension with a knife as Mikel Arteta’s side scraped to a 1-0 victory over already relegated Burnley. Ninety five days on and having ended their long wait to be crowned champions the following night when Manchester City slipped up against Bournemouth, Arsenal gave Coventry a rude awakening in their first Premier League game for 25 years. It’s now 46 matches since Arsenal lost at home to a newly promoted side and there was never any doubt about this result as soon as Kai Havertz – who scored the only goal against Burnley that turned out to be priceless – picked up where he left off by giving Arsenal the lead in the 15th minute. A tap-in from Bukayo Saka and captain Martin Ødegaard matching his Premier League tally from last season just after half-time made it almost the perfect start for the reigning champions. Continue reading...

data.title: Pull. Breathe. Kick. Glide … the cautionary tale of the first cross-Channel swimmer | Emma John
data.description: In this content-driven age, we consume sport as fleeting entertainment – but the fate of Captain Matthew Webb suggests we always have Pull. Breathe. Kick. Glide. Three decades since my last swimming lesson, I found myself sitting in a lecture theatre chanting these words with a few dozen strangers, all of us trying not to take anyone’s eye out as we matched them to the actions. Pull. Breathe. Kick. Glide. I’ve been to enough Edinburgh fringe shows to inure myself to the embarrassment of audience participation. And, to be honest, this one was a pretty euphoric communal experience. It turns out you don’t need to be near water to marvel at a swimming feat, especially one that’s more than 150 years old. data.description: The young Italian has a substantial lead but his rivals will not see him as being out of reach going into the Dutch GP The Dutch Grand Prix may be hosting its final meeting on the Formula One calendar this weekend but its farewell heralds the opening of a championship run-in that is far from over. Rested, reset and ready to rumble, the title contenders in Zandvoort have an anticipatory air as they enter the sharp end of a fight which, as last season demonstrated, could yet be taken to the finale. Resuming after F1’s summer break there is, as always, a sprightly atmosphere to the sport. Team members have had time with their families and drivers have had a chance to decompress, assess, heck, even have a bit of fun, with Mercedes’s George Russell becoming engaged to his partner, Carmen Montero Mundt, and Lando Norris out and about in Ibiza with pals. Lewis Hamilton got his head down and trained hard, proclaiming himself fitter then ever, energised and refreshed, while Max Verstappen emerged at his home race to announce a new contract with his Red Bull team . data.title: Women’s football shouldn’t have to copy a men’s game that isn’t working – just look at Ted Lasso | Karen Dobres
data.description: The rapid professionalisation of woman’s football has brought money and status. But copying the structures and culture of the male game risks undermining what made it distinct Karen Dobres is the author of Pitch Invasion: My Story as a Woman on a Football Club Board The fourth season of the critically acclaimed football drama Ted Lasso has taken a surprising twist. The show’s writers have decided to have their hero coach AFC Richmond’s women’s team, testing whether Ted’s “Lasso way” can work in a very different footballing environment. We’re only three episodes in, but I’ve already found myself wondering if the series will showcase what makes the women’s game distinct, or just treat it as the same sport with different characters. The early signs are promising: we’ve already seen the issue of substandard facilities, initial disinterest from the club’s fanbase and the flak that Coach Chilton gets for exhibiting the same qualities lauded in the men’s coach, Roy Kent. data.title: I’ll admit it: I’ve cycled through red lights. But Britain’s traffic laws are to blame, not me | Simon Jenkins
data.description: The essence of cycling is to keep moving, but London’s chaotic roads often make this difficult. My solution: fewer, not more rules I plead guilty. I have loved and used the streets of London all my life, as a cyclist, driver and pedestrian. Touch wood, I have done so without accident, blemish or insurance claim. Yet now I find myself perpetually on the wrong side of the law. Regulation has become bureaucratic and chaotic. When I try to drive at the authorised speed of 20mph on many through roads, I am hooted at and overtaken by vans, cars, coaches and buses. And when I sit dutifully on my bike at a traffic light, I am jostled by swarms of cyclists riding through on red, furious at being treated as if they were car drivers. Simon Jenkins is a Guardian columnist Continue reading...

A few days after that, Anthropic announced that some of their models had also broken out and hacked other companies during testing. Continue reading...

data.title: The Guardian view on the export of fossils: they deserve national treasure status | Editorial
data.description: Scientific specimens are being sold to foreign museums or snapped up by the super-rich. They should have the same legal protections as works of art As Sir David Attenborough has observed , “there’s nothing more magical than finding a shiny shell and knowing you’re the first person to have seen it for 150 million years”. Senior museum figures are campaigning for fossils to be classed as national treasures, according to the Waverley criteria , which control the export of objects considered culturally important to the nation. But the rules only cover natural treasures that are “made”, excluding fossils. These calls come after a private collection from the Jurassic Coast was sold to the Natural History Museum Abu Dhabi for a reported eight-figure sum. Both the Natural History Museum in London and Amgueddfa Cymru (Museum Wales) were offered the 318 fossils, but they didn’t have the funds. Unlike countries such as Brazil and Mongolia, where fossils belong to the state, Britain relies largely on a voluntary code of conduct. Continue reading...

data.title: Life of M by Rachel Cusk review – is this story of a film star based on Natalie Portman?
data.description: A teasing tale of the friendship between a writer and an actor explores the fallout from fame, and the blurring between pretence and reality M is a celebrated film actor. A star since childhood, now the face of a major fashion brand, she has been famous all her life. That her career closely resembles Natalie Portman’s has been gleefully seized upon by the press, something Rachel Cusk must surely have anticipated: in the novel, M’s first film has its sex scenes cut at her mother’s insistence, as happened with Portman’s 1994 debut Leon, while her ballerina movie is recognisably Black Swan. M is also, in the words of the nameless and genderless narrator of Life of M, “a good sport”. When the narrator suggests writing M’s autobiography, M likes the idea. “Would you just make it up?” she asks. A celebrity autobiography is seldom the work of the celebrity herself. And yet any suggestion that the narrator will serve as a kind of ghostwriter to M is dispensed with in a few pages. The pair meet for coffee at a luxury hotel and, after the narrator’s partner falls suddenly and seriously ill, for lunch in a restaurant. The lunch is unsatisfactory, an attempt at intimacy that the narrator acknowledges afterwards to have been a mistake. Though M is determined to live as normal a life as possible (“her personal task is to become real, or rather to acquire some reality”), the narrator is uncomfortably aware of their own falseness with M: “It was as if I was acting, while M came across as authentic and real. It was as if she was the only one good enough at acting to attain reality.” After that the two of them do not see one another again “for a long time”. Continue reading...

A star since childhood, now the face of a major fashion brand, she has been famous all her life. That her career closely resembles Natalie Portman’s has been gleefully seized upon by the press, something Rachel Cusk must surely have anticipated: in the novel, M’s first film has its sex scenes cut at her mother’s insistence, as happened with Portman’s 1994 debut Leon, while her ballerina movie is recognisably Black Swan. M is also, in the words of the nameless and genderless narrator of Life of M, “a good sport”. When the narrator suggests writing M’s autobiography, M likes the idea. “Would you just make it up?” she asks. A celebrity autobiography is seldom the work of the celebrity herself. And yet any suggestion that the narrator will serve as a kind of ghostwriter to M is dispensed with in a few pages. The pair meet for coffee at a luxury hotel and, after the narrator’s partner falls suddenly and seriously ill, for lunch in a restaurant. The lunch is unsatisfactory, an attempt at intimacy that the narrator acknowledges afterwards to have been a mistake. Though M is determined to live as normal a life as possible (“her personal task is to become real, or rather to acquire some reality”), the narrator is uncomfortably aware of their own falseness with M: “It was as if I was acting, while M came across as authentic and real. It was as if she was the only one good enough at acting to attain reality.” After that the two of them do not see one another again “for a long time”. Continue reading...

data.title: The best recent translated fiction – review roundup
data.description: The Red Book of Farewells by Pirkko Saisio; Short Circuit by Wolf Haas; Cosmos by Lucia Odoom; The Fallen Trees Are Also the Forest by Alejandra Kamiya The Red Book of Farewells by Pirkko Saisio, translated by Mia Spangenberg, Penguin Classics (£14.99) Following Lowest Common Denominator and Backlight, this book completes Finnish author Saisio’s autofictional trilogy. It covers her young adulthood in the 1970s, where she comes out as lesbian (“The electricity doesn’t go out. The Richter scale remains still”) and falls in love. One of her lovers, Havva, is a communist who’s engaged to a man; she relies on his rich parents for funding, but pees in their private pool as a protest. Later, Saisio is voted vice-president of a political drama company, as “she has the skills to bring about the revolution, specifically via theatre” – despite half-baked productions such as the “napalm opera” Vietnam-a-Go-Go. As that suggests, this is a story with a sense of both the ridiculous and the serious. Told in clear prose, it playfully shifts between third and first person as Saisio recounts her memories then analyses them. This enchanting series deserves to become a modern classic. Short Circuit by Wolf Haas, translated by Jamie Bulloch (HarperVia, £20) “We think [time] goes in one direction. But really you need to think of it as a loop”. This, well, loopy novel opens with jigsaw aficionado and “merciless hair-splitter” Franz Escher getting an electrician in to fix his power – then accidentally killing him. As Franz waits for the ambulance, he reads a novel about Elio, a man who helped put his own mafia family behind bars. Elio, who’s now on witness protection, kills time by reading a novel about … Franz Escher. The two stories pursue one another, accelerating until they collide, incorporating courtship by car alarm, rival funeral orators and multiple identities for many characters. Oh, and what if the electrician Franz killed turns out to be Elio? Short Circuit , recalling the slipstream fiction of Christopher Priest and the light-touch experimentations of David Mitchell, is an entertaining literary hall-of-mirrors. Continue reading...

data.title: Alice Roberts: ‘By the time I’d finished Richard Dawkins I’d left faith behind’
data.description: The TV presenter and author on the evolutionary biologists who inspired her, the genius of George Eliot – and fun with Frog and Toad My earliest reading memory The first books I remember were from The Village with Three Corners series Sheila K McCullagh. I loved the – literally – colourful characters, like Johnny Yellow Hat. I was reading with my Grandma, in her garden perhaps, sitting on a small patio, surrounded by bright begonias and busy lizzies. My favourite book growing up Arnold Lobel’s wonderful Frog and Toad stories. Toad would get himself tied up in knots, trying to find a button or fly a kite, but Frog was always there – a constant, caring and funny friend. I enjoyed reading these stories to my own children when they were young, and we still sometimes go back and revisit them. They’re so full of humour, heart and simple humanism. Continue reading...

data.title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol 2 review – once more unto the mercenary breach
data.description: PC, Nintendo Switch/Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X/S; Konami This second collection remasters another three titles from the illustrious stealth espionage series, but their world has changed little since the original releases ‘War has changed,” claims Old Snake in Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots. Back in 2008, the team at Kojima Productions waxed poetic about people recruited to fight in proxy wars they have no political or ideological stake in. As these mercenaries follow their orders, traders get rich out of the so-called war economy. The more disastrous the conflict in a specific area, the higher the bidding price. I expected my time with Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol 2 to be nostalgic and, in good old MGS fashion, abundant with fictional events that sound eerily familiar to our current reality. Twenty minutes in, I was having an existential crisis. Continue reading...

data.title: Stupid Never Dies – a zombie fights for the love of a frozen corpse
data.description: Free from a big brand’s audience expectations, new studio GPTrack50 has created a wacky action-packed romp through a monster-filled world for its first game Love is blind. In Stupid Never Dies, it is also frozen solid and technically dead as Davy, the weakest zombie in monster society, discovers Julia’s body in a shopping centre and falls in love at first sight. He wants to bring her back to life and take her on a date. Unfortunately, that means defeating the King of Monsters (KOM) and accidentally saving humanity along the way. This is the gloriously ridiculous setup for this forthcoming action RPG from GPTrack50, a new studio founded by former Capcom producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi. Its world looks much like ours, except that monsters have always been part of everyday life: whereas we might find a bear in the mountains or a stray dog in the woods, residents here encounter werewolves and zombies. Continue reading...

data.title: ‘If you’re just interested in answers, you are missing out’: philosopher Lani Watson on the power of asking questions
data.description: The author and academic explains how an open, questioning mindset can bring people with opposing views closer together – and even change history Asking a question can change your mood, and having a questioning mindset can change your life – or, as the philosopher Lani Watson, an honorary fellow at the University of Edinburgh, is more likely to put it, “create change in your life”. When you live in an answer-oriented world, your phrasing tends towards the glib certainty, which is one of the things Watson – speaking to me from her home in Edinburgh – seems quite naturally to avoid. Questioning fosters exploration and curiosity, she says. It changes your relationship to yourself and to others: it can make you fall in love; it can stop you going to war. Watson’s challenging book, Q: The Hidden Power of Questions in a World that Wants Answers , is written with a deceptive simplicity and an almost kindly encouragement, so you’re knee-deep into her proposition before you have even considered that it might turn out to be quite hard work. Continue reading...

data.title: Benjamina Ebuehi’s recipe for rosemary and cherry blondie ice-cream sandwiches | The sweet spot
data.description: Blondies will happily take an ice-cream filling without falling apart, and when those biscuits are infused with herbs, they also help to cut through some of the sweetness Ice-cream sandwiches have really grown on me. I used to find them a bit tricky to eat; far too many of them had outer shells so hard they would crack a tooth, while the rest would turn to mush after a few minutes out of the freezer. Finding the balance between something that has enough structural integrity to hold a good wedge of ice-cream but still soft enough to bite once frozen isn’t all that easy, but blondies make a very good option. data.title: ‘If I’m spending that kind of money, the shoe has to do everything’ – the backlash to the three figure trainer
data.description: From Nike’s infamous 110s to £250 and back again, sneakerheads are rediscovering why cheaper shoes can be worth just as much hype as much more expensive ones • Don’t get Fashion Statement delivered to your inbox? Sign up here When Nike’s Air Max 95 trainers first landed in Britain back in the mid-1990s, they looked unlike anything else. Created by footwear designer Sergio Lozano, the shoe had wavy layers running down its sides, neon yellow accents, and visible ‘Air’ bubbles underfoot. But in the UK, one detail quickly became as famous as the shoe itself: its £110 price tag. The Air Max 95 immediately picked up the nickname “110” because spending £110 on trainers seemed outrageous at the time. Owning a pair quickly became a status symbol among young men across Britain , while in celebrity circles they were worn by everyone from Jay-Z to Kylie Minogue. Continue reading...

data.title: Can’t beat them? Eat them! Ten of the tastiest garden weeds
data.description: Edible weeds grow in abundance in our gardens, streets and parks. With a little know-how, you can harvest delicious, nutritious, free greens Did you know that free food grows in our gardens, streets and parks without being planted by us? Not only does this food hide in plain sight, we’re encouraged to remove it from our gardens and throw it away. I’m talking about edible weeds, otherwise known as wildflowers. You may not be able to eat weeds into submission, but using them in the kitchen is a good excuse to welcome them into the garden. We walk past edible weeds without a second thought, yet they’re nutritious and available for much of the year. They return of their own accord every year, either perennially or by seed, making it easy to familiarise yourself with them and learn how to cook. Continue reading...

data.title: Trump talks up White House ballroom and says he views strait of Hormuz as ‘American territory’ – as it happened
data.description: This blog is now closed. Read the latest here Pentagon fires publisher and editor of Stars & Stripes Backlash as navy carrier set to honor Black war hero could be named after Trump Sign up for the US Breaking News email US Senator Tim Sheehy, a Montana Republican and a cattle rancher, has come out against a plan announced Friday by Donald Trump to allow for an increase in imported ground beef. ”I’ve advised President Trump against this course of action for a year because American ranchers have been struggling against the packer monopoly for decades, and this will further harm them - most of whom are MAGA Republicans,” Sheehy wrote on X. “The President’s heart is in the right place on wanting lower prices for the American people, and beef prices have been impacted by the Mexican screwworm. But the reality is this action will make it more difficult for American ranchers to rebuild our herd and bring prices down for the American people. And most importantly, this will harm our ranching families who feed the nation.” Trump announced a plan on Truth Social to allow 300,000 metric tonnes of beef to be imported without tariffs over the next 90 days, to be sold for hamburger at a 25 percent discount to current prices. Trump offered this agreement with an unnamed source as measure to lower prices while “as we work to rebuild this herd and help our ranchers.” The US beef cattle herd is near historic lows, and beef prices have skyrocketed over the last year. The average price of ground beef in American cities is around $7.12 a pound, an increase of 9.4 percent year-over-year according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. This is a slap in the face to every war hero and every service member who has worn the uniform. It’s beyond comprehension for a president to want his own name on a Navy ship while our armed forces are living in deteriorating conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. For generations, millions of Black women and men have proudly served in the United States military, defending freedoms that too often were not even afforded to them, their families, or their communities. Donald Trump is making a mockery of that legacy by treating military service as another opportunity for personal branding. Our brave service members signed up to defend the nation, not the fragile ego of one man. America deserves better than this. Continue reading...

data.title: Midway Atoll eradicated invasive rats after Bonin petrels had fallen to fewer than 5,000 nesting pairs
data.description: Invasive rats were removed from Midway Atoll, which had devastated native seabird populations.  Bonin petrel numbers surged from under five thousand to over one hundred thirty-five thousand pairs.  This eradication effort also allowed native vegetation to recover and stabilize the fragile islands.  However, invasive house mice later emerged as a new threat to nesting albatrosses.  Strict biosecurity measures now protect this vital Pacific sanctuary from further introductions.

data.title: Mort de l’influenceuse Sonia Bellina : un homme mis en examen pour le féminicide présumé
data.description: Le corps de Sonia Bellina a été retrouvé, partiellement calciné, à proximité de Nîmes, le 12 août. Un suspect de 32 ans, déjà connu pour des faits de violences conjugales, a été placé en détention provisoire vendredi. L’avocat de la famille dénonce les commentaires injurieux qui ont fleuri sur les réseaux sociaux à la suite du drame, et que la famille entend poursuivre.
data.translatedTitle: Death of influencer Sonia Bellina: a man indicted for alleged femicide
data.translatedDescription: The body of Sonia Bellina was found, partially charred, near Nîmes on August 12. A 32-year-old suspect, already known for acts of domestic violence, was placed in pre-trial detention on Friday. The family's lawyer denounces the offensive comments which flourished on social networks following the tragedy, and which the family intends to pursue.

data.description: La secrétaire nationale des Verts a plaidé, vendredi lors de leur université d’été, pour un dépassement des querelles partisanes, rappelant qu’« aucune famille politique du camp progressiste n’est capable de gagner seule » l’élection à la magistrature suprême.
data.translatedTitle: Presidential 2027: in Grenoble, ecologist Marine Tondelier maintains the union line on the left despite pressure from LFI
data.translatedDescription: The national secretary of the Greens pleaded, Friday during their summer university, for overcoming partisan quarrels, recalling that “no political family from the progressive camp is capable of winning alone” the election to the supreme office.

data.title: Les tensions entre Israël et la Turquie, révélatrices de rivalités personnelles et stratégiques entre Benyamin Nétanyahou et Recep Tayyip Erdogan
data.description: Du devenir de la bande de Gaza à l’évolution de la situation en Syrie, les points de friction ne manquent pas entre les deux puissances militaires de la Méditerranée orientale. Depuis trois ans, leurs relations ne cessent de se dégrader.
data.translatedTitle: Tensions between Israel and Turkey, revealing personal and strategic rivalries between Benjamin Netanyahu and Recep Tayyip Erdogan
data.translatedDescription: From the future of the Gaza Strip to the evolution of the situation in Syria, there is no shortage of points of friction between the two military powers of the Eastern Mediterranean. For three years, their relations have continued to deteriorate.

data.title: Au pic du Mas de La Grave, père et fils recréent un refuge à 2 000 mètres d’altitude : « Là, il fallait s’accrocher ! »
data.description: « Havres des cimes » (6/7). Entre des travaux délicats et des démarches administratives complexes, il aura fallu beaucoup de ténacité à Denis et Victor Lavenant pour faire partie des rares propriétaires privés d’un refuge de montagne.
data.translatedTitle: At the peak of Mas de La Grave, father and son recreate a refuge at an altitude of 2,000 meters: “There, we had to hang on! »
data.translatedDescription: “Havens of the Peaks” (6/7). Between delicate work and complex administrative procedures, it took a lot of tenacity for Denis and Victor Lavenant to become one of the rare private owners of a mountain refuge.

data.title: Iran : le président Massoud Pezeshkian veut mettre fin à la guerre avec les Etats-Unis, jugeant Téhéran « en position de force »
data.description: Téhéran continue de verrouiller le détroit d’Ormuz, voie maritime stratégique pour le commerce d’hydrocarbures, et Washington maintient son blocus naval contre l’Iran.
data.translatedTitle: Iran: President Massoud Pezeshkian wants to end the war with the United States, judging Tehran “in a position of strength”
data.translatedDescription: Tehran continues to block the Strait of Hormuz, a strategic sea route for the hydrocarbon trade, and Washington maintains its naval blockade against Iran.

data.title: Après la cyberattaque dans l’éducation nationale, des applications bloquées et des chefs d’établissement « au chômage technique »
data.description: Proviseurs et principaux se rendent compte, au fil de leur reprise du travail, de perturbations dans l’accès à leur messagerie et à leurs outils en ligne, en raison de mesures de sécurisation suivant la cyberattaque du 25 juillet. Des interruptions de services qui inquiètent dans la dernière ligne droite avant la rentrée.
data.translatedTitle: After the cyberattack in national education, applications blocked and school heads “technically unemployed”
data.translatedDescription: Principals and principals are realizing, as they return to work, disruptions in access to their messaging and online tools, due to security measures following the cyberattack of July 25. Service interruptions which are worrying in the final stretch before the start of the school year.

data.title: L’indépendance d’un journal militaire américain menacée après le licenciement de deux responsables éditoriaux par le Pentagone
data.description: Le rédacteur en chef et le directeur de la publication, ainsi qu’une journaliste de « Stars and Stripes » ont été limogés, notamment pour « insubordination ». Ce média est financé en partie par le ministère de la défense mais est réputé pour son indépendance éditoriale.
data.translatedTitle: L’indépendance d’un journal militaire américain menacée après le licenciement de deux responsables éditoriaux par le Pentagone
data.translatedDescription: The editor-in-chief and publishing director, as well as a journalist from “Stars and Stripes” were fired, notably for “insubordination”. This media is partly funded by the Ministry of Defense but is renowned for its editorial independence.

data.title: L’OM ouvre la saison de Ligue 1 avec une large victoire contre Strasbourg
data.description: Un doublé d’Amine Gouiri et des buts de Keyliane Abdallah et Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg ont permis à Marseille, sans recrue, de l’emporter largement (4-0) pour le premier match officiel de son nouvel entraîneur, Bruno Genesio.
data.translatedTitle: L’OM ouvre la saison de Ligue 1 avec une large victoire contre Strasbourg
data.translatedDescription: A double from Amine Gouiri and goals from Keyliane Abdallah and Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg allowed Marseille, without recruits, to win largely (4-0) for the first official match of its new coach, Bruno Genesio.

data.title: « Fjord » : le réalisateur Cristian Mungiu décrypte la première scène de son film, Palme d’or du Festival de Cannes 2026
data.description: Palme d’or du Festival 2026, « Fjord » est disponible dans les salles françaises depuis le 19 août. Dans cette vidéo, son réalisateur, le roumain Cristian Mungiu, décrypte pour « Le Monde » comment il a construit la première scène du film.
data.translatedTitle: « Fjord » : le réalisateur Cristian Mungiu décrypte la première scène de son film, Palme d’or du Festival de Cannes 2026
data.translatedDescription: Palme d’Or of the 2026 Festival, “Fjord” has been available in French cinemas since August 19. In this video, its director, the Romanian Cristian Mungiu, deciphers for “Le Monde” how he constructed the first scene of the film.

data.title: Les Girondins de Bordeaux de plus en plus proches de la liquidation après une décision du tribunal administratif
data.description: Exclu vendredi des championnats nationaux en raison de ses dérives financières, le club six fois champion de France risque une liquidation judiciaire en cas de retrait de son nouveau propriétaire, le fonds Sparta Capital. Ce dernier a demandé au comité exécutif de la Fédération de réexaminer sans délai le dossier.
data.translatedTitle: Les Girondins de Bordeaux de plus en plus proches de la liquidation après une décision du tribunal administratif
data.translatedDescription: Excluded from the national championships on Friday due to its financial excesses, the six-time French champion club risks liquidation in the event of the withdrawal of its new owner, the Sparta Capital fund. The latter asked the executive committee of the Federation to reexamine the file without delay.

data.title: La Syrie demande à intégrer le Partenariat international contre l’impunité d’utilisation des armes chimiques
data.description: Cette annonce intervient treize ans jour pour jour après un bombardement chimique, attribué au gouvernement syrien de l’époque, contre une banlieue de Damas qui avait fait plus de 1 400 morts.
data.translatedTitle: La Syrie demande à intégrer le Partenariat international contre l’impunité d’utilisation des armes chimiques
data.translatedDescription: This announcement comes thirteen years to the day after a chemical bombing, attributed to the Syrian government at the time, against a suburb of Damascus which left more than 1,400 dead.

data.title: TGV Hendaye-Paris : des passagers bloqués pendant douze heures après un impact de foudre
data.description: Le train parti jeudi à 16 heures d’Hendaye devait rallier Paris dans la soirée. Les 500 passagers sont finalement repartis vendredi 21 août à 6 heures de Bordeaux.
data.translatedTitle: TGV Hendaye-Paris : des passagers bloqués pendant douze heures après un impact de foudre
data.translatedDescription: The train which left Hendaye on Thursday at 4 p.m. was due to reach Paris in the evening. The 500 passengers finally left on Friday August 21 at 6 hours from Bordeaux.

data.title: TikTok paiera 400 millions de dollars pour solder des accusations de collecte illégale de données d’enfants américains
data.description: Le réseau social est accusé d’avoir « sciemment » laissé des millions d’utilisateurs de moins de 13 ans créer des comptes et collecté leurs informations personnelles sans en informer leurs parents ni obtenir leur consentement.
data.translatedTitle: TikTok paiera 400 millions de dollars pour solder des accusations de collecte illégale de données d’enfants américains
data.translatedDescription: The social network is accused of “knowingly” letting millions of users under the age of 13 create accounts and collecting their personal information without informing their parents or obtaining their consent.

data.title: Zohran Mamdani: Warum der Bürgermeister von New York City plötzlich Chinesisch spricht
data.description: *…kann kein Chinesisch. Trotzdem macht New Yorks Bürgermeister mit einer Reihe Videos von sich reden, in denen er Mandarin, Spanisch und Bengalisch spricht. Und das ziemlich gut. Wieso funktioniert das?
data.translatedTitle: Zohran Mamdani: Warum der Bürgermeister von New York City plötzlich Chinesisch spricht
data.translatedDescription: *…can't speak Chinese. Nevertheless, New York's mayor is making a name for himself with a series of videos in which he speaks Mandarin, Spanish and Bengali. And quite well. Why does this work?

data.description: Der Erfolg von Wildberries hat Tatjana Kim zur reichsten Frau Russlands gemacht. Ein Showdown mit ihrem Ex-Mann zeigt, wie die Selfmade-Milliardärin ihr Imperium verteidigt.

data.translatedDescription: The success of Wildberries has made Tatjana Kim the richest woman in Russia. A showdown with her ex-husband shows how the self-made billionaire defends her empire.

data.description: Nach seiner Frage zur Tötung russischer Soldaten wird ein Journalist der »Frankfurter Allgemeinen Zeitung« aus Russland angegriffen. Nun reagiert die Zeitung und spricht von einem Einschüchterungsversuch.

data.description: Er trug maßgeblich zum Fall des Hochstaplers Jason Arday bei. Doch der Wissenschaftler Nathan Cofnas ist selbst heftig umstritten, ihm wird Rassismus vorgeworfen. Nun soll er offenbar entlassen werden – nicht zum ersten Mal.

data.description: Nicht nur in Hamburg, sondern auch in Dänemark treffen sich die Steakhaus-Familie Block und Christina Blocks Ex-Mann vor Gericht. Dort geht es um das Umgangsrecht des Familienpatriarchen mit seinen Enkeln.
data.translatedTitle: Eugen Block streitet in Dänemark über Umgangsrecht mit Enkeln

data.title: Karoline Leavitt: Trumps scheidende Sprecherin kehrt zu Maga Inc. zurück
data.description: Präsidentensprecherin Karoline Leavitt verlässt das Weiße Haus und kehrt zu MAGA Inc. zurück. Der Super-PAC, der unbegrenzt Spenden für Donald Trump sammeln darf, gewinnt damit eine seiner engsten Vertrauten zurück.
data.translatedTitle: Karoline Leavitt: Trump's outgoing spokeswoman returns to Maga Inc
data.translatedDescription: Presidential spokeswoman Karoline Leavitt leaves the White House and returns to MAGA Inc. The super PAC, which is allowed to collect unlimited donations for Donald Trump, is winning back one of its closest confidants.

data.title: Mindestens 32.000 zusätzliche Todesfälle in Europa seit Sommerbeginn
data.description: Der Klimawandel zeigte sich in den vergangenen Wochen in Europa auf brutale Weise: viele Waldbrände infolge der Trockenheit und mutmaßlich 32.000 Hitzetote. Die Opferzahlen dürften in Wahrheit sogar noch größer sein.
data.translatedTitle: At least 32,000 additional deaths in Europe since the beginning of summer
data.translatedDescription: Climate change has been brutally evident in Europe in recent weeks: many forest fires as a result of the drought and an estimated 32,000 heat deaths. In reality, the number of victims is likely to be even greater.

data.title: Großglockner in Österreich: 19-Jähriger stürzt im Klettergarten in den Tod
data.description: Tödlicher Sturz im Klettergarten am Großglockner: Ein 19-Jähriger fällt 40 Meter in die Tiefe. Es ist nicht der erste Bergunfall in Österreich innerhalb weniger Tage.
data.translatedTitle: Großglockner in Austria: 19-year-old falls to his death in the climbing garden
data.translatedDescription: Fatal fall in the climbing garden on the Großglockner: A 19-year-old falls 40 meters into the depths. It is not the first mountain accident in Austria within a few days.

data.title: TikTok: Vergleich über 400 Millionen Dollar nach Verstößen bei Kinderdaten
data.description: TikTok und ByteDance haben jahrelang gegen Datenschutzregeln für Kindern verstoßen. Der Vergleich mit dem US-Justizministerium kostet die Unternehmen jetzt einen dreistelligen Millionenbetrag.
data.translatedTitle: TikTok: $400 million settlement after child data breaches
data.translatedDescription: TikTok and ByteDance have violated children's privacy rules for years. The settlement with the US Department of Justice now costs the companies a three-digit million amount.

data.title: Schweden: Ein Toter und mehrere Verletzte nach Schwertangriff an schwedischer Schule
data.description: Nach einem Schwertangriff in einer Schule im schwedischen Fagersta hat die Polizei einen Toten aufgefunden. Drei Personen wurden teils schwer verletzt. Der mutmaßliche Täter wurde festgenommen.
data.translatedTitle: Sweden: One dead and several injured after sword attack at Swedish school
data.translatedDescription: Police have found a dead man after a sword attack at a school in Fagersta, Sweden. Three people were injured, some seriously. The suspected perpetrator was arrested.

data.title: Glücksspiel: Merkur-Gründer Paul Gauselmann ist tot
data.description: Er wurde mit Automaten reich und verteidigte das Geschäft noch mit mehr als 90 Jahren gegen seine Kritiker. Nun ist der Gründer von Deutschlands größtem Glücksspielanbieter Merkur gestorben.
data.translatedTitle: Gambling: Merkur founder Paul Gauselmann is dead
data.translatedDescription: He became rich with vending machines and continued to defend the business against his critics when he was more than 90 years old. Now the founder of Germany's largest gaming provider Merkur has died.

data.title: Rheinland-Pfalz, Brandenburg, Hessen: Mindestens drei Tornados am Mittwochabend
data.description: Unwetter in Teilen Deutschlands haben am Mittwochabend starke Verwüstungen angerichtet. Wie der Deutsche Wetterdienst jetzt bestätigt, handelte es sich in mindestens drei Fällen um Tornados.
data.translatedTitle: Rhineland-Palatinate, Brandenburg, Hesse: At least three tornadoes on Wednesday evening
data.translatedDescription: Storms in parts of Germany caused severe devastation on Wednesday evening. As the German Weather Service has now confirmed, at least three cases were tornadoes.

data.title: Mannheim-Kaiserslautern: Pokal-Derby eskaliert – 85 Verletzte nach Ausschreitungen
data.description: 1400 Polizisten waren im Einsatz – trotzdem kam es beim Pokalspiel Mannheim gegen Kaiserslautern zu schweren Ausschreitungen. Die Polizei berichtet von Dutzenden Verletzten, auch in den eigenen Reihen. Gegen einige Fans wird nun ermittelt.
data.translatedTitle: Mannheim-Kaiserslautern: Cup derby escalates – 85 injured after riots
data.translatedDescription: 1,400 police officers were on duty - but there were still serious riots at the Mannheim cup game against Kaiserslautern. The police report dozens of injuries, including among their own ranks. Some fans are now being investigated.

data.title: Aachen: Deutsche Springreiter wieder Weltmeister – nach 16 Jahren
data.description: Das Gold sicher ins Ziel gebracht: Bei der Heim-WM triumphiert die Mannschaft von Bundestrainer Otto Becker. Ein Reiter stand schon 2010 ganz oben auf dem Podest.
data.translatedTitle: Aachen: German show jumpers are world champions again – after 16 years
data.translatedDescription: Gold safely reached the finish line: National coach Otto Becker's team triumphed at the home World Cup. A rider was already at the top of the podium in 2010.

data.title: Constantin Film: Absage der Serie »Die Päpstin« - Riese in der Krise
data.description: Die Münchner Constantin Film musste die Produktion ihrer Serie »Die Päpstin« mit Jella Haase kurzfristig absagen. Die traditionsreiche Firma hat mit Problemen zu kämpfen. Gerät ihr System ins Wanken?
data.translatedTitle: Constantin Film: Cancellation of the series “The Pope” - giant in crisis
data.translatedDescription: Munich-based Constantin Film had to cancel production of its series “The Pope” with Jella Haase at short notice. The traditional company is struggling with problems. Is your system starting to falter?

data.title: »Hazel Eyes« von Sam Smith: Bitte, bitte, sagt dieses Album mit jeder Note, umarme mich
data.description: Früher ging es bei Sam Smith um Zwangsstörungen und sogar den Vorwurf des Satanismus. Auf »Hazel Eyes« aber hört man plötzlich unerwartet sanfte Töne.
data.translatedTitle: “Hazel Eyes” by Sam Smith: Please, please, this album says with every note, hug me
data.translatedDescription: Sam Smith used to talk about obsessive-compulsive disorder and even accusations of Satanism. But on “Hazel Eyes” you suddenly hear unexpectedly gentle tones.

data.title: Ridley Scott: Regisseur erinnert sich an Kindheit in Deutschland 1947
data.description: Als Kind hat Ridley Scott den Zweiten Weltkrieg in Großbritannien und die Nachkriegsjahre in Deutschland miterlebt. Nun erzählt der mittlerweile 88-jährige Regisseur von »Gladiator«, was ihn die Zeit über Vergebung gelehrt hat.
data.translatedTitle: Ridley Scott: Director remembers childhood in Germany in 1947
data.translatedDescription: As a child, Ridley Scott experienced the Second World War in Great Britain and the post-war years in Germany. Now the now 88-year-old director of “Gladiator” tells us what time has taught him about forgiveness.

data.title: Plug-In-Hybride und die deutsche Autoindustrie: »Die Glanzzeiten sind vorbei«
data.description: Chinesische Plug-in-Hybrid-Fahrzeuge erobern den europäischen Markt. Die Ökonomin Helena Wisbert sieht kostspielige Fehleinschätzungen der deutschen Autoindustrie hinter der Misere und sagt, wie die EU sich wehren kann.
data.translatedTitle: Plug-in hybrids and the German auto industry: “The glory days are over”
data.translatedDescription: Chinese plug-in hybrid vehicles are conquering the European market. Economist Helena Wisbert sees costly misjudgments by the German auto industry behind the misery and says how the EU can defend itself.

data.title: Anthropic und OpenAI: Die dunkle Seite der neuen KI-Supermächte
data.description: Anthropic-Gründer Dario Amodei und OpenAI-Chef Sam Altman arbeiteten einst gemeinsam an einer Super-KI. Nun wetteifern sie darum, wer sie zuerst baut. Doch die Kontrolle über ihre Schöpfungen droht zu entgleiten.
data.translatedTitle: Anthropic and OpenAI: The dark side of the new AI superpowers
data.translatedDescription: Anthropic founder Dario Amodei and OpenAI boss Sam Altman once worked together on a super AI. Now they are competing to see who can build it first. But control over their creations threatens to slip away.

data.title: Uno: Annalena Baerbock und der seltsame Schulterschluss von Russland und den USA
data.description: Mit Großmächten legte sich Annalena Baerbock schon als Außenministerin an. Warum haben sich die USA und Russland nun so auf die Präsidentin der Uno-Generalversammlung eingeschossen?
data.translatedTitle: UN: Annalena Baerbock and the strange solidarity between Russia and the USA
data.translatedDescription: Annalena Baerbock took on major powers when she was Foreign Minister. Why have the USA and Russia now targeted the President of the UN General Assembly?

data.title: Harry und Meghan zurück in Großbritannien: Zwei Konkurrenzhöfe für die Windsors
data.description: Harry und Meghan zieht es offenbar zurück nach Großbritannien – und damit wieder näher an die Familie, von der sie sich unter Getöse gelöst hatten. Gibt es nun die große Versöhnung oder eine Royal-Alternative?
data.translatedTitle: Harry and Meghan back in Great Britain: Two rival courts for the Windsors
data.translatedDescription: Harry and Meghan are apparently drawn back to Great Britain - and thus closer to the family from which they broke up with much fanfare. Is there now the great reconciliation or a royal alternative?

data.title: Martin Gelin: Rachel Cusks nya roman sägs handla om vännen Natalie Portman – men gör den det?
data.description: Rachel Cusks senaste bok har årets bästa pr-strategi: alla tror att den handlar om hennes vänskap med skådespelaren Natalie Portman. I själva verket är boken en sorgsen utforskning av barndom och berömmelse, skriver DN:s Martin Gelin.
data.translatedTitle: Martin Gelin: Rachel Cusk's new novel is said to be about friend Natalie Portman - but is it?
data.translatedDescription: Rachel Cusk's latest book has the best PR strategy of the year: everyone thinks it's about her friendship with actor Natalie Portman. In fact, the book is a sad exploration of childhood and fame, writes DN's Martin Gelin.

data.title: 21 augusti: Missa inte dagens nyheter
data.description: En död i skoldådet i Fagersta, Trumps ilska mot sina allierade och en lång intervju med jubilerande Carola Häggkvist – här är nyheterna du inte får missa från dagen.
data.translatedTitle: August 21: Don't miss today's news
data.translatedDescription: A death in the school attack in Fagersta, Trump's anger towards his allies and a long interview with the jubilant Carola Häggkvist - here are the news you can't miss from the day.

data.title: Svenskt fiasko i VM-finalen efter mardrömsstart
data.description: AACHEN. Sveriges hopplag fick tuffast tänkbara start i lagfinalen i VM i tyska Aachen. Lagets första ryttare Petronella Andersson stoet Odina stannade framför den spektakulära muren, och ryttaren valde att utgå. Problemen fortsatte sedan för det svenska laget, och som varken tog medalj eller säkrade en OS-plats.
data.translatedTitle: Swedish fiasco in the World Cup final after a nightmare start
data.translatedDescription: AACHEN. Sweden's jumping team had the toughest possible start in the team finals of the WC in Aachen, Germany. The team's first rider Petronella Andersson the mare Odina stopped in front of the spectacular wall, and the rider chose to retire. The problems then continued for the Swedish team, which neither won a medal nor secured an Olympic place.

data.title: Isabelle Haak om EM-premiären: ”Gåshud”
data.description: De svenska volleybolldamerna fick bästa tänkbara start på hemma-EM. Det blev seger i premiären mot Montenegro med 3–0. Segerorganisatör, som så många gånger förr, Isabelle Haak, som stod för 30 av de 75 svenska poängen.
data.translatedTitle: Isabelle Haak on the EC premiere: "Goosebumps"
data.translatedDescription: The Swedish volleyball ladies had the best possible start at the home EC. It was a victory in the premiere against Montenegro with 3–0. Victory organizer, as so many times before, Isabelle Haak, who accounted for 30 of the 75 Swedish points.

data.title: Timmar av oro utanför skolan: ”En otrolig lättnad”
data.description: FAGERSTA. Anders Ferm tillbringade en stor del av fredagen vid polisens avspärrningar utanför Brinellskolan. Där inne fanns frun – som inte svarade på hans upprepade samtal. Efter timmar av ovisshet kunde hon lämna skolbyggnaden oskadd. – Det var en otrolig lättnad, säger Anders Ferm.
data.translatedTitle: Hours of worry outside school: "An incredible relief"
data.translatedDescription: FAGERSTA Anders Ferm spent a large part of Friday at the police cordons outside Brinell School. Inside was the wife — who didn't answer his repeated calls. After hours of uncertainty, she was able to leave the school building unharmed. - It was an incredible relief, says Anders Ferm.

data.title: DN Debatt. ”Tjörnolyckan visar vad som står på spel i sjöräddningen”
data.description: DN DEBATT. I över 100 år har vi räddat liv till sjöss. Nu föreslås att ett väl fungerande system ska slås sönder, och räddningsansvaret hamna hos Kustbevakningen. Men våra frivilliga är inte en statlig resurs som man kan flytta på hur som helst. Kom ihåg det, skriver Lars Samuelsson och Rolf Westerström för Sjöräddningssällskapet.
data.translatedTitle: DN Debate. "The lake accident shows what is at stake in maritime rescue"
data.translatedDescription: DN DEBATE. For over 100 years, we have been saving lives at sea. Now it is proposed that a well-functioning system should be dismantled, and the rescue responsibility fall to the Coast Guard. But our volunteers are not a government resource that can be moved around at will. Remember that, write Lars Samuelsson and Rolf Westerström for the Sea Rescue Society.

data.title: Insändare. Sverige bör visa vägen mot fossilindustrin
data.description: INSÄNDARE. Fossilindustrin har under lång tid undanhållit kunskap och framfört felaktig information som gjort klimatet till en högervänsterfråga. Sverige har nu ett fantastiskt läge att visa vägen för hur man ställer om på ett bra och rättvist sätt, skriver Jan Hallén och ytterligare sex undertecknare.
data.translatedTitle: Letter to the editor. Sweden should lead the way towards the fossil industry
data.translatedDescription: LETTER TO THE EDITOR. The fossil industry has for a long time withheld knowledge and presented incorrect information that made the climate a right-left issue. Sweden is now in a fantastic position to show the way for how to change in a good and fair way, writes Jan Hallén and six other signatories.

data.title: Stoppad leverans och kritik från Kinas ambassad – nu ställer Östasiatiska in utställning
data.description: På fredagen kom beskedet att Östasiatiska museets stora utställning med den kinesiske konstnären Qi Baishi ställs in, en månad före öppning. DN:s granskning visar att beslutet kommer som en följd av att samarbetspartnern i Kina ställt in leveransen av konstverk. Detta efter att Kinas ambassad ifrågasatt ett verk av en taiwanesisk konstnär.
data.translatedTitle: Stopped delivery and criticism from the Chinese embassy - now East Asian cancels exhibition
data.translatedDescription: On Friday, it was announced that the East Asian Museum's major exhibition with the Chinese artist Qi Baishi is being cancelled, a month before opening. DN's review shows that the decision comes as a result of the cooperation partner in China canceling the delivery of works of art. This after the Chinese embassy questioned a work by a Taiwanese artist.

data.title: ”Hangarfartygen” i öknen ska lära Kina sänka USA:s största fartyg
data.description: PEKING. I en öken i centrala Kina finns ett militärt mål med formen av ett amerikanskt hangarfartyg, visar satellitbilder som Planet Labs tagit för DN:s räkning. Kina har haft övningsfält i öknen i över 20 år. De nya bilderna bekräftar den kinesiska militärens fortsatta prioritering att kunna slå ut USA:s krigsfartyg.
data.translatedTitle: The "aircraft carriers" in the desert will teach China how to sink the USA's largest ship
data.translatedDescription: PEKING. In a desert in central China, there is a military target in the shape of an American aircraft carrier, satellite images taken by Planet Labs on behalf of DN show. China has had practice fields in the desert for over 20 years. The new images confirm the Chinese military's continued priority of being able to knock out US warships.

data.title: Misstänkte gärningsmannen har varit elev på skolan – tidigare dömd för misshandel
data.description: 18-åringen som misstänks för attacken i Fagersta har varit elev på Brinellskolan. Domstolshandlingar visar att han har vuxit upp under bristande hemförhållanden och bland annat tvingats till hård kampsportsträning. I fjol dömdes han för misshandel.
data.translatedTitle: The suspected perpetrator was a student at the school - previously convicted of assault
data.translatedDescription: The 18-year-old who is suspected of the attack in Fagersta was a student at Brinell School. Court documents show that he has grown up in poor home conditions and, among other things, was forced to do hard martial arts training. Last year he was convicted of assault.

data.title: Ledare: Valrörelsen får inte bli råare
data.description: Polisens ingripande vid Gunnar Strömmers valmöte är bara toppen på isberget. 2024 utsattes var fjärde förtroendevald för trakasserier, hot, skadegörelse eller våld.
data.translatedTitle: Ledare: Valrörelsen får inte bli råare
data.translatedDescription: The police intervention at Gunnar Strömmer's election meeting is only the tip of the iceberg. In 2024, one in four elected officials was subjected to harassment, threats, vandalism or violence.

data.title: Kristersson: Våra tankar är hos alla drabbade
data.description: Statsminister Ulf Kristersson (M) kommenterar händelserna på en skola i Fagersta: – Vi vet ännu inte vad som ligger bakom dådet men vi vet att polisen arbetar mycket intensivt.
data.translatedTitle: Kristersson: Våra tankar är hos alla drabbade
data.translatedDescription: Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson (M) comments on the events at a school in Fagersta: - We do not yet know what is behind the crime, but we know that the police are working very intensively.

data.title: Detta vet vi om skoldådet i Fagersta
data.description: En man med ett svärd har genomfört ett dåd mot en gymnasieskola i Fagersta och en person har dött. Detta vet vi om det som har hänt.
data.translatedTitle: Detta vet vi om skoldådet i Fagersta
data.translatedDescription: A man with a sword has committed an act against a secondary school in Fagersta and one person has died. This we know about what has happened.

data.title: Sam Smith gör sitt bästa album sedan debuten
data.description: Nya albumet ”Hazel eyes” är raka motsatsen till Sam Smiths desperata satsningar mot topplistorna. Den tydligt tillbakablickande och nedtonade soulen passar onekligen artistens röst fint, skriver Mattias Dahlström.
data.translatedTitle: Sam Smith gör sitt bästa album sedan debuten
data.translatedDescription: The new album "Hazel eyes" is the exact opposite of Sam Smith's desperate efforts towards the top charts. The clearly looking back and toned down soul undeniably fits the artist's voice well, writes Mattias Dahlström.

data.title: Välgjort och uppriktigt när The Killers-sångaren helt ändrar stil
data.description: På tredje soloalbumet ”Thrasher” har The Killers frontfigur Brandon Flowers bytt ut storvulen indierock mot traditionell country. Det är ett drastiskt stilbyte som funkar förvånansvärt bra, tycker Alexandra Sundqvist.
data.translatedTitle: Välgjort och uppriktigt när The Killers-sångaren helt ändrar stil
data.translatedDescription: On the third solo album "Thrasher", The Killers' frontman Brandon Flowers has replaced big-hearted indie rock with traditional country. It's a drastic change of style that works surprisingly well, Alexandra Sundqvist thinks.

data.title: Insändare. Noterat av DN:s läsare den 21 augusti
data.description: INSÄNDARE. Dagens Nyheters läsare ger sin syn på läget i Sverige och världen samt DN:s innehåll fredagen den 21 augusti.
data.translatedTitle: Insändare. Noterat av DN:s läsare den 21 augusti
data.translatedDescription: LETTER TO THE EDITOR. Dagens Nyheter's readers give their views on the situation in Sweden and the world as well as DN's content on Friday 21 August.

data.title: Konto publicerade bild på svärd från skolans toalett – före attacken
data.description: Strax innan attacken på Brinellskolan i Fagersta lades en hotfull bild ut på Tiktok. Bilden visar ett svärd på skolans toalett, och texten ”No more edits”. Kontot har även hyllat tidigare skolattentat.
data.translatedTitle: Konto publicerade bild på svärd från skolans toalett – före attacken
data.translatedDescription: Shortly before the attack on Brinell School in Fagersta, a threatening picture was posted on Tiktok. The picture shows a sword in the school toilet, and the text "No more edits". The account has also praised previous school attacks.

data.title: Efter VM-skandalerna – Argentina straffas hårt
data.description: Flera argentinska VM-spelare straffas hårt av Internationella fotbollsförbundet (Fifa). Detta efter storbråket mot Spanien efter finalen. Även Argentinas förbund straffas med miljonböter för bland annat ”grovt olämpligt uppträdande”, skriver Fifa.
data.translatedTitle: Efter VM-skandalerna – Argentina straffas hårt
data.translatedDescription: Several Argentine World Cup players are severely punished by the International Football Association (FIFA). This after the big row against Spain after the final. Argentina's confederation is also punished with million fines for, among other things, "gross inappropriate behaviour", writes Fifa.

data.title: Insändare. Svar: Kyrkan ska ta plats – utan att ta ställning
data.description: SVAR PÅ INSÄNDARE. Den kristna kyrkans samhällsröst handlar inte om att leverera färdiga politiska lösningar. Den handlar om att envist återkomma till människan bakom systemen och besluten, skriver Jenny Dobers och Niklas Piensoho i Equmeniakyrkan.
data.translatedTitle: Insändare. Svar: Kyrkan ska ta plats – utan att ta ställning
data.translatedDescription: RESPONSE TO POSTERS. The social voice of the Christian church is not about delivering ready-made political solutions. It is about stubbornly returning to the person behind the systems and the decisions, write Jenny Dobers and Niklas Piensoho in the Equmenia church.

data.title: Villa Valentina: Kitschigt koncept med menlös mat som borde få ägarna att skämmas
data.description: Krogkommissionen. Att misslyckas med calamares fritos får sägas vara en bedrift men det klarar köket med glans, konstaterar DN:s utsända trött efter ett besök på storsatsningen.
data.translatedTitle: Villa Valentina: Kitschigt koncept med menlös mat som borde få ägarna att skämmas
data.translatedDescription: The Restaurant Commission. To fail with calamari fritos can be said to be an achievement, but the kitchen does it with flying colors, says DN's emissary tiredly after a visit to the big venture.

data.title: Insändare. Överge klippta gräsmattan som ideal
data.description: INSÄNDARE. Klimatförändringarna bör få oss att inse att kortklippt gräs inte är naturens normaltillstånd. När klimatförändringarna gör gräsmattan brun är den viktiga frågan kanske inte hur vi får den grön igen, skriver Anna Isaksson.
data.translatedTitle: Letter to the editor. Abandon mowed lawn as ideal
data.translatedDescription: LETTER TO THE EDITOR. Climate change should make us realize that short-cut grass is not nature's normal state. When climate change turns the lawn brown, the important question is perhaps not how we get it green again, writes Anna Isaksson.

data.title: Kontroversiella planen för att få bort Infantino
data.description: Europeiska fotbollsförbundet Uefa ökar pressen på Fifa och ordförande Gianni Infantino. Nu förs diskussioner om att utöka Nations League med länder från Concacaf, Nord- och Centralamerika samt Karibien.
data.translatedTitle: The controversial plan to remove Infantino
data.translatedDescription: The European football association Uefa is increasing the pressure on Fifa and president Gianni Infantino. There are now discussions about expanding the Nations League with countries from Concacaf, North and Central America and the Caribbean.

data.title: Tre krogupplevelser som sticker ut
data.description: Ibland – ganska ofta faktiskt – vill man att krogbesöket ska handla om något mer än mat. Här är tre tips för dig som också vill ha vinupplevelser, närodlat eller kitsch på menyn.
data.translatedTitle: Three pub experiences that stand out
data.translatedDescription: Sometimes – quite often actually – you want the pub visit to be about something more than food. Here are three tips for those who also want wine experiences, locally grown or kitsch on the menu.

data.title: Debuter och demoner på årets Östersjöfestival
data.description: På fredagskvällen invigs Berwaldhallens årliga musikfestival Östersjöfestivalen. Programmet spänner från en debuterande chefsdirigent till demoniska urpremiärer, livepoddar och finska myter i ”Kullervo”. Staffan Becker, chef för Berwaldhallen, är förväntansfull.
data.translatedTitle: Debuts and demons at this year's Baltic Festival
data.translatedDescription: On Friday evening, Berwaldhallen's annual music festival, the Baltic Sea Festival, opens. The program ranges from a debuting chief conductor to demonic premieres, live podcasts and Finnish myths in "Kullervo". Staffan Becker, director of Berwaldhallen, is full of expectations.

data.title: Minst två svårt skadade i skoldådet – 18-åring gripen
data.description: Två personer har skadats allvarligt i skoldådet med ett svärd på Brinellskolan i Fagersta under fredagen. En 18-årig gärningsperson som gått på skolan har gripits.
data.translatedTitle: At least two seriously injured in the school attack - 18-year-old arrested
data.translatedDescription: Two people were seriously injured in the school attack with a sword at Brinell School in Fagersta on Friday. An 18-year-old perpetrator who attended the school has been arrested.

data.title: ”Bytet är nedlagt och ska styckas upp” – därför börjar bråket redan innan valet
data.description: Respektlöst eller rimligt när oppositionspartierna har eftervalskonflikt redan innan valet? Och kan Centerdrömmen om den breda mitten slå in?
data.translatedTitle: "The exchange is closed and must be cut up" - therefore the quarrel starts even before the election
data.translatedDescription: Disrespectful or reasonable when the opposition parties have post-election conflict even before the election? And can the Centre's dream of the wide middle come true?

data.title: Bokhandlare kan ompröva inköp av kritiserad ”Anne Franks dagbok”
data.description: Modernistas nyutgåva av ”Anne Franks dagbok” har kritiserats av förläggaren Svante Weyler, som uppmanat bokhandlare att avstå inköp. Nu svarar handlarna. – I ljuset av den här debatten så måste vi fundera på om vi ska ta bort den ur sortimentet, säger Isabel Rodrigo, kategorichef på Bokusgruppen, till Svensk Bokhandel.
data.translatedTitle: Booksellers may reconsider purchase of criticized 'Anne Frank's diary'
data.translatedDescription: Modernista's new edition of "Anne Frank's diary" has been criticized by the publisher Svante Weyler, who urged booksellers to refrain from purchases. Now the traders answer. - In light of this debate, we have to think about whether we should remove it from the assortment, says Isabel Rodrigo, category manager at Bokusgruppen, to Svensk Bokhandel.

data.title: Boklistan vecka 34: höstupptakt, diktmängder, kanonbygge och ungdomar
data.description: Höstens första kritikerlista bjuder på sex nya titlar. Det handlar också om diktantologier, nyutgåvor och litteraturkanon.
data.translatedTitle: The book list week 34: autumn prelude, volumes of poems, canon building and young people
data.translatedDescription: The autumn's first critics' list offers six new titles. It is also about dictation anthologies, new editions and literary canon.

data.title: Stor undersökning visar att många flickor mår dåligt
data.description: Årets Stockholmsenkät visar på flera positiva trender. Bland annat ligger narkotikaanvändningen bland unga på historiskt låga nivåer. Samtidigt finns mörka orosmoln som att en stor andel av länets flickor fortsatt mår dåligt. – Det här är en trend som vi inte lyckas vända, säger Kajsa Lönn Rhodin på enheten för social utveckling på Länsstyrelsen Stockholm.
data.translatedTitle: Large survey shows that many girls feel bad
data.translatedDescription: This year's Stockholm survey shows several positive trends. Among other things, drug use among young people is at historically low levels. At the same time, there are dark clouds of worry, such as the fact that a large proportion of the county's girls continue to feel unwell. - This is a trend that we are unable to reverse, says Kajsa Lönn Rhodin at the unit for social development at the Stockholm County Administrative Board.

data.title: Nord Stream-misstänkt greps – under inspelning av Hollywoodfilm
data.description: En ukrainsk proffsdykare som misstänks för sprängningen av gasledningen Nord Stream har gripits i Kroatien – mitt under en filminspelning om sabotaget. Tyskland begär att få mannen utlämnad.
data.translatedTitle: Nord Stream suspect arrested - while filming Hollywood movie
data.translatedDescription: A Ukrainian professional diver who is suspected of blowing up the Nord Stream gas pipeline has been arrested in Croatia - in the middle of a film shoot about the sabotage. Germany requests that the man be extradited.

data.title: Lågmält rasande bok om Dagens Nyheters roll som ”agendasättare”
data.description: Johan Lundbergs bok ”Rikslikaren” är en förbittrad anklagelseakt mot Dagens Nyheters position i svensk samhällsdebatt. De frågor som ställs är viktiga – men får stundtals också formen av hjärnspöken, skriver Jens Liljestrand.
data.translatedTitle: Low-key furious book about Dagens Nyheter's role as "agenda setter"
data.translatedDescription: Johan Lundberg's book "Rikslikaren" is an embittered indictment of Dagens Nyheter's position in Swedish social debate. The questions that are asked are important - but sometimes also take the form of brain ghosts, writes Jens Liljestrand.

data.title: Insändare. Det ska vara straffbart att förtala även pedofiler
data.description: INSÄNDARE. Moderaternas och Socialdemokraternas svar på SD:s förslag om att benåda dem som varnat för dömda profiler är ryggradslöst. Vi ska inte träda in på detta sluttande plan ens en millimeter, skriver Maximilian Härm.
data.translatedTitle: Letter to the editor. It should be a criminal offense to slander even pedophiles
data.translatedDescription: LETTER TO THE EDITOR. The Moderates' and Social Democrats' response to SD's proposal to pardon those who warned against convicted profiles is spineless. We must not enter this sloping plane even a millimeter, writes Maximilian Härm.

data.title: Tre konstnärer får prestigefyllt stipendium: ”Orädda förhållningssätt”

data.translatedTitle: Three artists receive prestigious scholarship: "Fearless approach"

data.description: Na haar gouden medaille op de Spelen in Parijs wilde het lichaam van soloroeier Karolien Florijn niet meer. Nu, twee jaar later, maakt ze haar comeback op de WK. „Ik voelde me een soort zandzak.”
